info.name: OpenSea Account Endpoints Token Endpoints API

items.docs: Retrieve multiple tokens in a single request by providing a list of contract identifiers (chain and address). Not-found tokens are silently omitted from the response.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: chains
params.description: Filter by blockchain(s)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor for next page

items.docs: Get a paginated list of token groups sorted by market cap descending. Token groups represent equivalent currencies across different blockchains (e.g., ETH on Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum are all in the "eth" token group).

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort field (default: usd_value)

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Sort direction (default: desc)

params.name: disable_spam_filtering
params.description: When true, disables OpenSea's heuristic spam filtering and returns tokens that would normally be hidden (low liquidity, dust, flagged-as-spam, etc.). Tokens flagged for trust & safety enforcement or as malicious are still filtered out regardless. Surfaced tokens carry a `status` field on the response indicating why they would have been filtered.
